compiled_state.description:
## Summary

Found by the parity census while fixing bug `antelopine-limivorous-chinchilla` (library/MCP reads
masking an absent store as an empty one). That fix guards the library read boundary at
`_reads._tracker()`, which covers the CLI, library, and MCP surfaces. Two AUTOMATED callers
bypass that boundary entirely by calling the low-level reducer directly, so they retain the old
silent behavior on an absent store:

- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/impossible_links.py:182` — `for state in reduce_all_tickets(tracker_dir)`
- `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/relation_snapshot.py:257` — `reduced = reduce_all_tickets(...)`

Both reach `src/rebar/reducer/_api.py:257-260`, which wraps `os.listdir(tracker_path)` in
`except OSError: return results`. `FileNotFoundError` is an `OSError`, so a missing tracker
reduces to `[]` with no error.

The public `rebar.reduce_all_tickets` export (`src/rebar/__init__.py:143,235`) has the same
property. That low-level tolerance is DELIBERATE and was left in place by the sibling fix —
other callers rely on it — so the correct remedy here is at the two call sites, not in the
reducer.

## Why this was filed rather than fixed in scope

Both callers run against a store that has already been established by the time they execute (the
reconciler after store setup, plan review against a materialized snapshot), so neither is a
reachable production failure today the way the MCP read surface was. That makes this a latent
parity gap rather than an active defect, and folding it into the sibling bug would have widened a
proven single-site fix into a speculative one. Filed so the gap is recorded rather than silently
left, per the debug protocol's rule that every MISSING census slot gets an explicit disposition.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `impossible_links` and `relation_snapshot` either resolve their tracker through a guarded
      boundary, or document why an absent store is legitimately a no-op for them.
- [ ] Whichever way it is resolved, a test pins the chosen behavior for both call sites against a
      non-existent tracker directory.
- [ ] `reducer/_api.py` keeps its `except OSError` tolerance (other callers depend on it) — the
      fix belongs at the call sites.
compiled_state.title: Reconciler and plan-review read the reducer directly, bypassing the library read guard on an absent store
